BrochureContent.Content:
Liam Reilly Auctioneers are delighted to present Apartment 15, The Walk, Block 4, Moyglare Hall, Maynooth to the market. This bright and spacious two-bedroom, two-bathroom ground-floor apartment extends to approximately 59.88 sq. m. (645 sq. ft.) and enjoys a well-designed layout within the highly regarded Moyglare Hall development.

Presented in good condition throughout, the accommodation comprises an entrance hall with excellent storage, a generous open-plan kitchen/living area with direct access outside, two double bedrooms, one with ensuite, and a separate main bathroom. 

The property also benefits from a C BER rating, timber flooring throughout much of the accommodation and generous fitted storage.

Ideally suited to first-time buyers, downsizers and investors alike, Apartment 15 represents an excellent opportunity to acquire a spacious and conveniently located apartment within easy reach of Maynooth town centre, Maynooth University and excellent transport links to Dublin.

The property forms part of an attractive, modern apartment building finished in a combination of red brick and render. Being positioned at ground-floor level is a particular advantage, with the generous open-plan kitchen/living area benefiting from direct access to the outside through double glazed doors, creating a bright and airy living space.

Internally, the accommodation is well laid out and extends to an entrance hall with useful storage and hot press, a large open-plan kitchen/living area, two generous double bedrooms, one with ensuite, together with a separate main bathroom.

The kitchen/living area, measuring approximately 5.4m x 4.0m, is the heart of the apartment. The kitchen is fitted with an extensive range of cream wall and floor units with contrasting worktops and tiled splashback, together with integrated oven and hob. There is ample room for both living and dining areas, while attractive timber flooring adds warmth to the space. A particularly appealing feature is the set of glazed double doors with adjoining full-height glazed panels, which flood the room with natural light and provide direct access to the exterior.

There are two well-proportioned double bedrooms. Bedroom 1 measures approximately 3.6m x 2.8m, while Bedroom 2 measures approximately 3.6m x 3.5m. Both rooms are finished with timber flooring and benefit from good natural light, while fitted wardrobes provide valuable storage. One bedroom also enjoys the convenience of a private ensuite shower room, which is tiled and fitted with a shower enclosure, wash-hand basin and WC.

The main bathroom, approximately 2.4m x 1.8m, is generously proportioned and finished with neutral tiling. It comprises a bath with shower attachment and glazed shower screen, WC and pedestal wash-hand basin.

The entrance hallway is finished with timber flooring and provides access to all accommodation, as well as a hot press and separate storage cupboard particularly useful features in apartment living.

Overall, Apartment 15 offers an excellent combination of space, practicality and location. While the property would benefit from some cosmetic updating, it provides a very good blank canvas for a new owner to put their own stamp on and should appeal to first-time buyers, downsizers and investors alike.

Location
Moyglare Hall is a popular and well-established residential development in a highly convenient position just off the Moyglare Road. The development is within comfortable walking distance of Maynooth University, Maynooth town centre, local schools, shops, restaurants, cafés and sporting amenities. Maynooth Train Station provides commuter rail services to Dublin city centre, while regular bus services and convenient access to the M4 make the location particularly attractive to commuters. 

Maynooth itself is a thriving university town offering an excellent range of shopping and leisure facilities, including Manor Mills Shopping Centre, together with an extensive selection of restaurants, pubs and cafés. The combination of a vibrant town centre, university campus and excellent transport connections continues to make Maynooth one of North Kildare's most sought-after residential locations.
